faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the NEIGRIHMS Senior Resident Doctor recruitment is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident Doctor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 58 vacancies available for the Senior Resident Doctor post in NEIGRIHMS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post graduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the respective subject, have completed compulsory internship after MBBS, and be registered with any State Medical Council/NMC.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident Doctor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67700 Per Month plus NPA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident Doctor role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Document Screening followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which departments have vacancies for Senior Resident Doctors?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in various departments including Anaesthesiology, General Medicine, General Surgery, Paediatrics, and many others as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article or by visiting the official website of NEIGRIHMS.
